$comment: The REAL wire frames dig-node emits for its miss contract, transcribed field-for-field from
the node's own source and its own assertions rather than from an assumption about them:
and carries NO data member; see also
The hex ids and the 10.0.0.7:9444 address are the node test's own mock values, kept verbatim
so a reader can diff this file against that test.
KNOWN DIVERGENCE, recorded rather than papered over: dig-rpc-protocol's ErrorData declares
data.code (the UPPER_SNAKE machine code) and data.origin on EVERY canonical error, but the
node builds these frames by hand and emits neither. The SDK therefore branches on the NUMERIC
code, which is what is actually on the wire. Reported upstream on the parent ticket.

redirect.message: content not held by this node; re-request against a provider in data.redirect

rate_limited.message: miss lookup rate limit exceeded for this requestor; back off and retry

inconclusive.message: availability could not be established: part of the search did not answer, so this is not a not-found and the request may be retried

not_found.message: resource not available at the requested root
